title: OK for a beginner but too small for us.
text: OK for a beginner but too small for us.. This is a very small air fryer, even with two shelves.  The rotisserie basket works well for fries and is easy to clean. The unit I received had scratches on the inside from shipment and the front door would not close properly, resulting in heat and steam escaping around the door. I returned it and will order something larger.
